question: The offer was made in good faith and was genuine. It was:
explanation: bona fide: Genuine; made in good faith.

reasons.A: Wrong: Not frank; crafty and insincere.
reasons.B: Wrong: To speak evil of someone; to slander.
reasons.C: Wrong: Willing to believe almost anything.
reasons.D: Correct: Genuine; made in good faith.

question: Her loyalty to her husband never wavered over the years. This faithfulness is her:

reasons.D: Wrong: A tendency to believe too easily.

question: The person who has no faith or religion was called an:
explanation: infidel: A person without faith or religion.

reasons.A: Wrong: A person who flatters the powerful to gain favor.
reasons.B: Correct: A person without faith or religion.
reasons.C: Wrong: A person who gives money and time to help others.
reasons.D: Wrong: One who hates the human race.

question: Unfaithfulness in marriage broke her trust and made her angry. This unfaithfulness is:

reasons.B: Wrong: The quality of being believable.
reasons.D: Wrong: A tendency to believe too easily.
